hints.label: nudge
hints.text: Time grows with the size of the customer. Count statements, not seconds.

hints.label: pointer to the signal
hints.text: Enable a statement counter on the connection and compare 3 orders with 300. The count grows linearly, in more than one place (orders, then their lines, then products).

hints.label: near-solution
hints.text: The report issues a query per order and another per line. Fetch orders, lines and product names with a JOIN or with IN-batched queries and group in Python; keep ordering and the empty-order cases the same.
